callbackEncoding: Interpreter operation tree; no JavaScript source is embedded.

missions.title: FIRST FLIGHT
missions.brief: Take the Kestrel up, run the navigation gates, and put rounds on the practice drones.

args: Kestrel is fuelled. Take her up and stay off my roof.
Gates first. They are lit teal — fly through the live one.
Good. Now the drones — they shoot back, but softly.
That will do. Bring her home.
Not bad for a first sortie.

missions.title: DISTRESS CALL
missions.brief: A cargo aircraft is under attack. Drive off the drones, recover the dropped Flight Core, and walk it home.

args: Mayday on the open channel. Cargo hauler, east of you.
We are hit — they came out of the cloud deck!

objectives.failText: The hauler is down. We needed that crew.

args: We dumped the Flight Core when the hull went. It is below you.
Staying on your wing. Take us in.

objectives.failText: The hauler is down. We needed that crew.

args: That recording is already on three team channels. Brace yourself.

missions.title: RECOGNITION
missions.brief: All three teams have seen the rescue. Hear them out.

args: Three calls in an hour. That is a record for my strip.
Vanguard. You held station over a civilian hull. That is our work.
Tempest. You flew a storm front in a museum piece. I like you already.
Inferno. You did not run. Come see what real guns feel like.
Fly all three trials before you sign anything. Understood?

missions.title: VANGUARD TRIAL — HOLD THE LINE
missions.brief: Escort three transports. You are scored on survivors, not kills.

args: Aras. Bulwark. Stay with the transports and we will get along.

objectives.failText: All three transports lost. That is the one score that matters.

args.else: You brought some of them back. Some.

args: Guardian Field is what we would put on your aircraft. Think on it.

missions.title: TEMPEST TRIAL — CUT THE STORM
missions.brief: Race the canyon line. Kai Mercer is already out there.

args: Mercer. Crosswind. Try not to redecorate the ridge.
You are flying it like a checklist. Move!
Velocity Burst would suit you. Come and take it.

missions.title: INFERNO TRIAL — TRIAL BY FIRE
missions.brief: Two waves, then Serrano. Manage your heat.

args: Calder. Targets first, then my champion. No cease signal games.
Serrano. Let us see what the coast taught you.
You did not flinch. That buys you a conversation.
Weapons Overdrive. It is yours if you sign.

missions.title: CHOOSE YOUR WINGS
missions.brief: Fly back to Breakwater Field and sign with a team.

args: That is the last of the three. Go home and think.
Three offers on my table. Come back and choose your own way.

objectives.text: SIGN WITH A TEAM IN THE HANGAR

args: Walk the hangar, or open FIT OUT. Vanguard, Tempest or Inferno.

args.left: Tempest do not run an Arena card, so you would fly the west
args.right: flight with them. It changes nothing about who you answer to.

missions.title: BUILT, NOT GIVEN
missions.brief: Fit the aircraft out. Every choice costs something.

args: Now build it. Nothing here is free — read the trade.

objectives.text: CONFIGURE YOUR AIRCRAFT IN THE HANGAR

args: She is yours now. Go and prove it.

missions.title: FIRST ARENA CORE MATCH
missions.brief: Your league debut. Deliver the Arena Core.

args: New name on the card tonight. Let us see it fly.

missions.title: BLACKOUT
missions.brief: The arena has lost power. Something is in the airspace that should not be.

args: We have lost the arena feed — stand by —
That is not a fault. Get airborne.
You are not the one I came for.

objectives.text: CHOOSE — PURSUE NYX, OR COVER THE SHUTTLE

args: Civilian shuttle is holed and dropping. Nyx is running for the storm.
Nyx escapes either way. Only one of these you can still change.

left.left: The three teams are accusing each other of the security failure.
left.right: Mara is sending you out over the wider region to find what the stolen

args: Tell them it was one of their own.

args.left: That attack was not meant to win. It was meant to make all three teams
args.right: look at each other instead of the sky.

missions.title: TOWER RAID
missions.brief: Black Wing drones are working the Skyway navigation masts. Hold the towers.

args: Three navigation masts are being worked over at once. That is not opportunism.
Nobody else is coming. The teams are still arguing about the arena.

left.left: DRIVE THE DRONES OFF THE MASTS (

args: Now fly a slow circuit over each one so the array can re-sync.
Three masts, one night, three regions apart. Somebody planned that.

missions.title: CONTRACT RUN
missions.brief: A settlement the teams stopped servicing needs a delivery. Fly the corridor and get the hauler in.

args: Ridgemouth has been off the Vanguard supply list for two months.
They pay in goodwill, which is worth more than it sounds.
Hauler is behind you and slow. Keep them off my tail.

objectives.failText: The hauler is down and Ridgemouth gets nothing. Again.

args: Ridgemouth will remember that. Settlements have long memories.

missions.title: FALSE COLOURS
missions.brief: Unmarked aircraft are flying with stolen team hardware. Take one down and read the wreck.

args: Unmarked flight, no transponder, and it is turning like a Tempest airframe.
If that is Tempest hardware in an unmarked hull, somebody is going to start a war over it.
Get low and hold over the debris field. The array needs a few seconds.

args.left: Vanguard command boards. Tempest engine governors. Inferno power cells.
args.right: All three, in one unmarked hull.

missions.title: SHADE
missions.brief: Nyx is flying escort over a civilian corridor. Intercept — and watch what they do.

args: Shade is up. Same corridor as the evening passenger run.
You again. Stay off my wing and nobody down there gets hurt.

left.left: INTERCEPT SHADE — KEEP THE LINER ALIVE (

objectives.failText: The liner is down. Nyx would not even have done that.

args: You noticed. I have not fired at the liner once.

args.left: You shot down the only one of mine who still argued with me.
args.right: Thank you.

args: Cassian would have shot it down to make a point. I am not Cassian.

missions.title: THE FRAGMENT
missions.brief: A Black Wing cache holds a piece of the control architecture. Take it, then decide who gets it.

args: Cache site, lightly held, and it is putting out a control signal.
There it is. Fly it through, same as a Core.

args.left: It is control architecture, and it is not finished. Whoever holds it
args.right: holds a piece of whatever Black Wing is building.

args.label: SHARE IT WITH ALL THREE TEAMS

args: All three, at once, in the open. Brave. Possibly stupid.
Your team will love you for it. The other two will not forget.
In my floor, under the compressor. Nobody looks under a compressor.

chapterEnd.left: You are a known quantity now. All three teams want to see how you

args.left: Whatever that thing is part of, it needs all three teams to build it.
args.right: Think about what that means.

missions.title: HOLD WITH ARAS
missions.brief: Lena Aras is running a civilian evacuation into contested air. She wants a wing, not a hero.

args: Aras. Four transports, one corridor, and I am not losing any of them.
Kills are yours if you want them. Survivors are mine.

objectives.failText: All four gone. Aras will not say a word about it, which is worse.

args.then: Four out of four. You fly like somebody who has lost people before.
args.else: We brought some of them home. I will take some.

missions.title: RUN WITH MERCER
missions.brief: Kai Mercer has found a route nobody has flown. He wants a witness who can keep up.

args: Mercer. I found a line through the ridge nobody has flown clean.
Beat me or do not, but do not fly it like a checklist.
You are flying it safe. Safe is slow.

args.then: That was flying. Come and find me when this all goes wrong.
args.else: You finished it. Most people do not finish it.

missions.title: BURN WITH SERRANO
missions.brief: Niko Serrano wants a straight fight, and then wants you to see what Inferno is protecting.

args: Serrano. One pass, no wingmen, no cease signal.
Good. Now the part I actually called you for.
That foundry feeds four settlements. Black Wing has been circling it for a week.

args.then: You did not give a metre of that line. Noted.
args.else: You held it. Expensively, but you held it.

args: Everyone thinks Inferno is the fist. Nobody asks what the fist is around.

missions.title: ACE HUNT
missions.brief: Black Wing is removing ace pilots. Two are down at once. You can only reach one first.

args: Two distress beacons. Both aces. Both being worked over right now.
Whoever you reach second is going to be on their own for a while.

args.left: Both will survive the night if you are quick. Only one of them will
args.right: remember that you came for them first.

args: You came. Get them off me and I will do the rest.

objectives.failText: You did not get there in time. Nobody is going to say it out loud.

args: Walk them back. The other beacon went quiet on its own.

objectives.failText: You lost them on the way home. That is the worst way to lose someone.

chapterEnd.left: Black Wing has stopped pretending this is about the Arena.
chapterEnd.right: Faction bases are being hit next, with each other’s signatures.

args.left: They are picking off the people who could organise a defence.
args.right: That is not a raid. That is a campaign.

missions.title: FALSE FLAG
missions.brief: A faction base is under attack by aircraft wearing somebody else’s colours.

args: Base under attack, and the attackers are squawking Tempest identifiers.
Tempest has nothing in that airspace. Nothing. Somebody is wearing our name.

args.left: Vanguard has three squadrons asking me for permission to answer that.
args.right: I am holding them. For now.

args: Hold over each wreck. I want the identifiers on record before anyone tidies up.
Vanguard has the same recording. We are still deciding whether to believe it.

missions.title: THE SHIPMENT
missions.brief: Follow a covert transport to whatever it is feeding. Do not shoot it down.

args: Do not kill it. A wreck tells you what it was carrying. A landing tells you who wanted it.

objectives.failText: You shot it down. Whatever it was going to, it is not going there now.

args: There. A relay nobody filed and nobody is admitting to.

args.left: Vanguard command architecture. Tempest governors. Inferno power.
args.right: All three, in one relay, wired together.

args: Those governors left our foundry in a sealed crate. Somebody signed for them.

missions.title: WITNESS
missions.brief: A Black Wing engineer wants out and will testify. Everyone would rather she did not arrive.

args: She built part of it. She will say so on an open channel if she lives to reach us.
You are carrying a defector through my airspace. Consider what that says about your judgement.

objectives.failText: The witness is dead and the recording died with her.

args: Last chance to be somewhere else.
She named the schism. Cassian did not leave Vanguard. He was asked to.

missions.title: THE LEDGER
missions.brief: The evidence implicates your own team as well. Cassian would very much like you to sit on it.

args: Cassian Veyr. You have been thorough. I would like to make you an offer.
Publish all of it and your own team burns with the rest. Publish half and you stay a hero.
I will let you think about it. My flight will keep you company.

args.left: The full record proves Black Wing manufactured this war. It also
args.right: proves your own team looked away while it happened.

args: Your own team will not speak to you for a month. The other two just started listening.
Your team is safe. So is the part of this that made it possible.
A pragmatist. I did not expect that. I am not sure I am pleased.

chapterEnd.left: It is proven, and it is too late — the shooting has already
chapterEnd.right: started in three regions at once.

args.left: Four independent sources. That is not an accusation any more,
args.right: it is a finding.

args.left: It is thin in places. Enough people want to believe it that
args.right: it will travel anyway. That is not the same thing.

args.left: Inferno will stand down its forward flights for seventy-two hours.
args.right: That is what I can give you.

args.left: Everyone knows now. Everyone is also already shooting.
args.right: Knowing was never going to be enough on its own.

missions.title: RECLAIM
missions.brief: A forward base has been taken. Take it back — guns first, then the mast.

args: They hold the west field. Guns, mast, the lot.

args.left: Aras. I have two flights holding the ridge and nothing to spare.
args.right: The field is yours to take.

args: Now stay on it. They will try to come back for it once.
West field is ours. That is one region that still has a working mast.

missions.title: DOWNED WINGS
missions.brief: Four pilots are down in contested air, and two of them fly for the wrong team.

args: Four beacons. Two are yours. Two are not.

args.left: I am not going to tell you which order to take them in.
args.right: I am going to remember the order you take them in.

objectives.failText: All four recovery flights lost. Every one of those beacons went quiet.

args.then: You went back for the ones flying the wrong colours. That is going to travel.
args.else: You got some of them out. It is more than anyone else managed today.

missions.title: WARDEN NODES
missions.brief: The control network has physical nodes. Take enough of them offline and it cannot finish.

args: Four nodes, spread wide on purpose so nobody can hit them all at once.

args.left: Four nodes, one aircraft, one night. I have run the numbers and
args.right: I do not like them. Go anyway.

args: That will slow it. It will not stop it — the carrier is the network now.

missions.title: TASK FORCE
missions.brief: Black Wing’s carrier is running for the central sky city. Decide who flies against it.

args: The carrier turned for the city an hour ago. Whatever you are going to build, build it now.

args.left: Vanguard, Tempest and Inferno will all send aircraft. They will not
args.right: all take orders from the same person.

args: Under an independent. Twenty years ago I would have refused. Go.
Your team, your way. The other two will hold their own line and no more.
Screen first. They always put the screen out ahead.

left.left: The Warden Network went live while you were flying. Navigation,
left.right: drones and half the automated defences across the central regions answer

args: It is on. Everything is on. Whatever you are going to do, do it fast.

missions.title: THE CITY
missions.brief: Defend the central sky city while its own systems fight it.

args: The city is flying blind. Its own defences are shooting at its own traffic.

args.left: Inferno has the southern approach. Take the north and we will not
args.right: have to talk about who is in charge.

args: Another wave. They are being fed straight off the network.
Three passenger hulls still up there with no navigation. Walk them out.

objectives.failText: All three passenger hulls are gone. That is what the network was for.

args.left: The city is still up there. Say what you like about the three of us —
args.right: nobody flew home tonight.

missions.title: LIGHTS ON
missions.brief: The Warden Network only works because it is the only navigation left. Bring the independent masts back.

args: Independent masts. Old, stubborn, and not on their network.

args.left: Tempest built half of those and then got told they were obsolete.
args.right: Light them up.

args: Fly a slow circuit over each one and they will come up on their own.
Five masts, all independent, all live. The sky has its own eyes again.

missions.title: THE CORRIDOR
missions.brief: The carrier sits behind a storm corridor and a defence line. Fly one, break the other.

args: Mercer. I have flown this corridor twice and I would not recommend it once.
Platforms. They are the carrier’s outer ring — nothing gets past them.
You flew it clean. I am putting that in writing where Kade can see it.

missions.title: THE CARRIER
missions.brief: Engines, drone bays, command relays. In that order.

args: You are inside my ship’s envelope. That is not the achievement you think it is.

args.left: Serrano. I am on your wing and I am not asking permission.
args.right: Call the engines first.

args.left: You have taken my engines. You have not taken the network.
args.right: It does not need me any more than it needs you.

missions.title: THE WARDEN CORE
missions.brief: Nyx, then Cassian, then the core. Then get off the ship.

args: I am on the bow. You knew I would be.
I am not going to fight you. I never was.
Cassian is on the command deck. I will hold the bay doors.
You never gave me a reason to do anything else.
Everything you have proved about me is true. It is also beside the point.
Somebody was always going to build this. I would rather it was somebody who has flown.
Hold station over the core. Do not let anything push you off it.

objectives.text: GET CLEAR — THE CARRIER IS COMING DOWN

args: It is losing height. Get west and do not look back.

objectives.text: DECIDE WHAT HAPPENS TO THE NETWORK

args.left: It works. That is the problem. Whoever holds it decides who flies,
args.right: and every one of these choices is somebody’s idea of safe.
